name: gba-pane
description: Play Game Boy Advance games in a side pane with /gba; they pause when Claude finishes or needs you.

romDir.title: ROM folder
romDir.description: Folder /gba searches by name and the picker lists (.gba and .zip files). Empty: the picker still lists recent ROMs and the run folder.

hd.title: Sharper picture
hd.description: 2x2 pixels per terminal cell (quadrant glyphs); off draws 1x2 half blocks.

idlePauseSeconds.title: Idle pause (seconds)
idlePauseSeconds.description: Pause after this long with no key or controller input; 0 never.
